They were coached, for the sixth year, by Kevin Willard.  They were members of the Big East Conference.  They finished the season 25–9, 12–6 in Big East play to finish in third place.  They defeated Creighton, Xavier, and the eventual national champion Villanova to become champions of the Big East Tournament.  They received the Big East Conference's automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament where they lost in the first round to Gonzaga.

2011–12 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team | The 2011–12 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team represented Seton Hall University during the 2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season.  The Pirates, led by head coach Kevin Willard, played its home games in Newark, New Jersey at the Prudential Center and are members of the Big East Conference.
